provenance.raw: equilibrium-weighted aligned L2 vs the RAW reference on the 97x97 cells (8 kT mask); its endpoint floor is the reference's own bootstrap noise
provenance.km: the same vs the row-normalised K_h * F_ref, h = 0.08 (kernel-matched; the kernel arm's accepted read-out)
provenance.raw_u8: uniform weight on the 8 kT mask vs the raw reference (sign check)
provenance.sm: estimate AND reference both smoothed at h = 0.08 (common read-out for cross-estimator endpoints)
